Final score: Red 31, Blue 47 (difference -16). Game G-haiku55-3 is over.

Strategy: For number cards I randomized uniformly among my remaining numbers in the early and middle rounds. A check on a numbers-only version of the game suggested that uniform play is an equilibrium, but that check used a simplified per-round value and ignored card holdings, so it is not a verified equilibrium. For actions I played the single-round equilibrium mix for each pair of numbers, adjusted for which cards each side still held (for example, I kept Traps for big-number rounds). From round 8 I solved the last two rounds exactly as small matrix games and played the resulting mixes; in round 9 I played the mixed equilibrium that the solved subgame gave.

Most of the deficit came from high-variance outcomes: Steal against Blue's Trap in round 4 cost 15 points, and Blue held the larger number in the early Hold-Hold rounds.

Other commands or tools used: none
